title: Companion-mediation 'call it a draw between them' is a will-check coin flip (roughly 50-65% by my rolls) that, on a miss, costs standing with BOTH quarreling companions equally - observed at both the barrow-doors dispute (Osk/Tamsin, both -1) and the Drowned-Hall covenant dispute (Lys/Osk, both -1). There is no lower-stakes 'just listen, take no side' option distinct from this persuasion attempt, so trying to stay neutral always risks souring both relationships at once.
where: The Empty Seat (Vale barrow) and the Drowned Hall covenant chamber (Meres) / speak with the company
